summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. The triple-SILAC channel map (light = GFP-RAB7A wild type unstimulated, medium = wild type + EGF 8 min, heavy = Y183F + EGF 8 min) is confirmed by Supplementary Fig. 6a and, independently, by the deposited MaxQuant data in both biological replicates (no label swap). File mapping, fractions, re-injection technical replicates, instrument and search parameters were all re-derived from fresh PRIDE, RAW-header, MaxQuant and publication evidence. Only minor improvements remain.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE project PXD001996 (title 'Multi-layered proteomics of EGFR signaling _Rab7 data'; SILAC; protocol 'Analysis on QExactive Plus'). Supplementary Figures PDF (MOESM22) page 10, Supp. Fig. 6a rendered and read: GFP-RAB7 Lys0/Arg0 (no EGF); '+ EGF 8 min.': GFP-RAB7 Lys4/Arg6 and GFP-RAB7 Y183F Lys8/Arg10; SILAC mix 1:1:1; SDS-PAGE; in-gel trypsin digestion. Paper (PMC7618131, title matched, cites PXD001996): HeLa from ATCC, SILAC DMEM, Lipofectamine transfection with GFP-tagged human RAB7 (GFPRAB7a) or Y183F, 100 ng/mL EGF, 8 min stimulation, GFP-trap IP, SDS-PAGE in-gel trypsin, Q-Exactive Plus for RAB7 interactome, MaxQuant 1.4.1.4, 'two biological replicates', 'SILAC experiments have been performed in duplicates'. Channel map verified in the data for both replicates: RAB7A peptides spanning Y183 (QETEVELYNEFPEPIK and extensions, Tyr->Phe site ID 15) have Ratio H/L 0.002-0.07 in rab7mu1 and 0.002-0.075 in rab7mu2 while every other RAB7A peptide has H/L 0.5-0.7, i.e. heavy carries Y183F in both replicates; M/L of those peptides is normal (0.35-0.65), so light and medium are both wild type. log2 normalized M/L of 2566 protein groups correlates between rab7mu1 and rab7mu2 (Pearson r = 0.70; a light/medium swap would give a negative correlation); EGF-recruited GRB2 (M/L 1.35 / 1.83; H/L 4.66 / 4.56) and EGFR (M/L 1.37 / 1.14; H/L 1.65 / 1.52) are enriched over light in both replicates, consistent with light = unstimulated in both. RAW headers (HTTP range reads, first 128 KB of all 19 files): all 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'; Top10 DDA, MS1 scan range 300 to 1750 m/z, NCE 25 identical in all 19. MaxQuant Rab7_parameters.txt: version 1.4.1.4, Carbamidomethyl (C) fixed, Acetyl (Protein N-term)/Gln->pyro-Glu/Oxidation (M) in protein quantification, site tables GlyGly (K), Oxidation (M), Phospho (STY), Tyr->Phe; MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm; no precursor tolerance recorded (so 'not available' is honest). Trypsin/P reproduced from Rab7_peptides.txt: 2084 peptides whose only internal K/R precedes P are counted as 1 missed cleavage, which MaxQuant does only with Trypsin/P.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files list (projectAccessions == ['PXD001996'] asserted for all 20 entries): 19 RAW + MaxQuantOutput.tar.gz. The set of comment[data file] values equals the 19 RAW names exactly; each file appears exactly 3 times, once per SILAC label. Every RAW appears in Rab7_ExpDesign.txt: 8 Exp1_* files -> rab7mu1, 11 Exp2_* files -> rab7mu2. RAW headers record the 11 deposited Exp2_* files as Exp3_* with identical date, fraction and injection suffix (consistent 1:1 rename, no cross-assignment); the SDRF correctly uses deposited names.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 2 biological replicates x 3 SILAC conditions = 6 source names; 19 runs x 3 channels = 57 rows. Biological replicate 1 = Exp1/rab7mu1, 2 = Exp2/rab7mu2, matching the paper's duplicate SILAC experiments. Fraction identifiers 1-7 match the ExpDesign Fraction column for all 19 files (7 gel slices), including re-injections F1b->1 (rep1), F2b->2, F4b->4, F7b->7, F4c->4 (rep2). Technical replicate 1 for F1-F7, 2 for F1b/F2b/F4b/F7b, 3 for F4c - consistent with README 'repeated measurements of the same sample (e.g., multiple injections)' and with MaxQuant pooling them into the same fraction. Factors: factor value[genotype] (wild type vs Y183F) and factor value[treatment] (untreated vs EGF) each vary and match characteristics; light vs medium isolates EGF, medium vs heavy isolates the Y183F mutation; same label-to-condition map in both replicates (verified above). characteristics[sampling time] 8 minute for both EGF channels and 'not applicable' for unstimulated, matching Supp. Fig. 6a '+ EGF 8 min'.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value was traced to PRIDE, the paper, Supp. Fig. 6a, Cellosaurus, RAW headers or deposited MaxQuant files; no value is stated more specifically than its source (disease uses the MONDO parent of Cellosaurus's HPV-related subtype; precursor tolerance is 'not available' because parameters.txt omits it; ancestry and passage are 'not available'). Optional reduction/alkylation reagent columns are omitted because the paper does not name them (only Carbamidomethyl (C) as a search modification). The GFP-trap IP is not encoded because EFO:0009090 has no fitting descendant (checked live: only cell-sorting terms, 'sample enrichment' and 'enrichment of phosphorylated protein'). Material omissions are limited to the minor findings below (recommended characteristics[individual] and characteristics[sample storage temperature] columns, EGF dose and serum starvation, transient-transfection context).

findings.location: characteristics[genotype] and factor value[genotype], all 57 rows
findings.message: The genotype values describe a transiently transfected GFP-RAB7A construct (Lipofectamine, assays 36 h after transfection), not the HeLa cells' own genotype. The column is licensed via TERMS.tsv and the 'GFP-' prefix makes the meaning clear, but readers may misread 'wild type' as a cell-line genotype.
findings.evidence: Paper Methods: 'HeLa cells were transfected using Lipofectamine ... assays were performed 36 hours after transfection'; 'GFP-tagged human RAB7 (GFPRAB7a) and its mutant ... (RAB7-Y183F) ... cloned into the pCEP4 vector'. TERMS.tsv also lists characteristics[genetic modification] (EFO:0000510). Correction criterion: optionally add characteristics[genetic modification] (e.g. transient transfection/overexpression) alongside the genotype column.
